description: Fired when a user successfully completes the sign-in flow (Supabase SIGNED_IN event detected). Top of the authenticated user funnel.
Fired when a new user account is created via the sign-up form. Critical for tracking rider/operator acquisition.
Fired when a user signs out. Used to measure session churn and calculate session duration.
Fired when a passenger opens the M-Pesa payment modal. Top of the payment conversion funnel.
Fired when the /reserve/pay API succeeds and M-Pesa prompt is initiated. Core revenue/conversion event.
Fired on payment error in the reserve/pay API. Used to track payment failure rate.
Fired when a passenger clicks 'Reserve a Seat' on a feed card, navigating to the reservation page.
Fired when the contact form is successfully submitted. Tracks inbound business leads and operator enquiries.
Fired when a user is redirected to Stripe checkout. Tracks operator plan adoption and billing funnel start.
Fired when a sacco staff member redeems an invite code and signs in. Tracks team onboarding conversion.
